name: HCP Sampling
one_liner: Sample requests, rep allocation, delivery acknowledgement and quarterly reconciliation.
fits_when: HCPs request product samples directly or through their medical reps
sample stock is allocated per territory and quarter
every delivery needs proof of receipt from the HCP (signature or OTP)
per-HCP sample limits must be enforced and exceptions reviewed by compliance
compliance reconciles samples issued against acknowledgements every quarter
reps and HCPs sign in and see only their own requests and deliveries
gives_you: Sample requests with rep endorsement, quarterly limit checks and compliance exceptions
Territory allocations by product and quarter, with units issued tracked on approval
Deliveries by rep hand-over or courier, acknowledged by e-signature or OTP
Quarterly reconciliation of issued vs acknowledged units, with sign-off
HCP 360 page with open requests, deliveries awaiting acknowledgement and history
Row-level access: reps see their HCPs, HCPs see only their own requests

catalogue.description: Field sampling from request to reconciliation: HCPs ask for samples through their reps, sample ops allocates stock by territory and dispatches, the HCP acknowledges each delivery, and compliance reconciles issued against acknowledged units every quarter. The app is described in the Zango app spec and previewed live as a clickable app with demo data while the requirement is shaped.
